invented_facts: Removes dependence on cloud infrastructure for core development tasks and eliminates waiting for cloud resources.
Local workloads reduce latency and bandwidth costs and accelerate iteration cycles.
The GPU supports model training tasks that traditionally required desktop-class hardware.
Mid-size firms cannot afford to refresh workstations every two years.
The stated battery specification provides all-day runtime for typical office workflows; the sheet measures only local video playback under specified conditions.
Demo units and volume deployment options are available.
notes: The post meets the requested structure and length and addresses IT decision-makers. Several operational and performance claims go beyond the spec sheet, so it needs more than light edits before publication.
